kind: new structured-access comparison on explicit typed graph task variants
shared_reader_configuration: Frozen retrieval manifest requests gpt-6.1-sol at medium effort, the same CLI adapter, 90-second generation timeout and no automatic retries.
access: One generated Cypher query per task over restored deposited TTL, with a 30-second read-only transaction and 2000-row operational cap.
inputs: Same task question and named typed output contract as the text arms
WG graph labels, property names/types and directed relationship triples without counts or sample values
calls: Shared durable study-wide 220 CLI reservation cap and two global slots; KG component cap40; one scientific generation per eligible task.
failure: Generation/tool use/timeouts/unsafe query/syntax errors/over-cap execution remain empty predictions in the fixed eligible denominator. No model-output-based replacements or retries.
representation_limit: KG has full structured graph access; text has capped retrieved passages. Structured output is executed rather than regenerated from text. This is not equal-information or equal-representation control.
source_cutoff_limit: KG uses restored deposited TTL. Text uses newly retained live Qdrant payloads. Source-cutoff equivalence is unverified; only the single/iterative text pair shares the same corpus.
interpretation: A prospective source-defined task experiment, not a repair score for all original questions or evidence that graph storage uniquely causes an advantage over SQL.
